core_obligations: Construction: the limit is the relative Spec of the colimit of the algebras over a chosen base index; transition maps give the projection system.
Universal property: morphisms from a test scheme into the constructed limit correspond bijectively to compatible families into the system, checked affine-locally and glued.
proof_roadmap: Relative Spec of the colimit algebra.
difficulty_reason: Relative Spec construction plus universal property verified by affine-local gluing. One construction, one verification.

compared.difference: The proposition uses existence of such limits as input; this lemma is the existence construction itself. Different statements.
